parts.label: Compressor
parts.note: Squeezes the vapour into a hot, high-pressure gas

parts.label: Condenser coil
parts.note: The gas gives off heat and condenses to liquid

parts.label: Expansion valve
parts.note: Drops the pressure, so the liquid turns very cold

parts.label: Evaporator coil
parts.note: The refrigerant boils, taking in heat

parts.label: Hot gas
parts.note: High pressure and hot after compression

parts.label: Heat out
parts.note: Heat goes out to the room (Q out)

parts.label: Heat in
parts.note: Heat taken from inside the fridge (Q in)
